what: Behind a text panel laid over a fixed background (video·photo), the blur goes from 0 to 8px over one screen of scroll — a veil that lets the Hero video recede gently by the time the next text is read · scope-recruit has a pale base-color veil (90%) stuck to the screen that blurs 0→8px from the first screen down to the lead section’s bottom edge while its opacity deepens 0→1, so the people photo in the Hero recedes (fade: 1; until: parent; look: plain) · brand is the overlay above the pinned Hero sea photo. From when the first line of the concept text rises 100px above the screen bottom until the text panel’s bottom edge touches the screen bottom, it blurs 0→41.1px and a sunset-colored veil (tint) covers it 0→1. Only within that range does the wave line (during) turn on, over 1s (trigger · max: 41.1 · look: plain)

options.span: Scroll distance until fully faded (in screen heights), default 1
options.fade: If 1, the curtain’s opacity also deepens from 0 to 1 (when laying a semi-transparent background-color curtain over the screen), default 0
options.until: With parent, it fully fades once the bottom edge of the section (parent) holding the curtain reaches the top of the screen (instead of span)
options.look: When plain, skips the .1s smoothing and binds directly to the scroll value
options.trigger: Section selector that sets the fade range — if given, it fades over this section’s start → end instead of span·until (brand concept text panel)
options.start: With trigger — start position (ScrollTrigger form), default top bottom · top bottom-=100」
options.end-trigger: Selector for measuring the end position from another element (default trigger)
options.end: Used with trigger — end position, default bottom bottom
options.[data-fx-part=tint]: (optional) a color-veil child that darkens from transparent 0 to 1 with progress — Brand sunset gradient
options.[data-fx-part=during]: (Optional) Inside the fade range (0<Progress<1) Pattern child that gets is-on only at this point and turns on over --fx-during-dur (default 1s) — brand wave line

use: <section data-fx="scroll-blur-veil" data-fx-scroll-blur-veil="max: 8">…Text over the fixed video…</section>
note: The panel itself must be transparent so the back looks blurred (backdrop-filter). The original applies the value on every scroll and joins them with a .1s ease
